files.html:
Brief

Lumen Agents: agents that run the back office for mid-market finance teams. A product seat is open and the founder has written about wanting someone who has run an adoption program inside a real business.

  1. Ask how the approval model works today.
  2. Ask who owns the customer's rollout.

Dossier

Lumen sells to finance and operations leaders at mid-market companies. Two rounds since founding, the last led by a top-tier fund. Hiring in product and go-to-market; engineering steady.

People

The founder was a VP at a public software company; the head of product left in the spring and has not been replaced. Two first-degree connections on the engineering team.

seat.html: Head of product, reporting to the founder, owning the roadmap and the first two PM hires.

operate.html: Two-week cycles; the founder runs product reviews.

ownership.html: Founder-led; the Series A fund holds a board seat.

items.label: Board
items.html: Founder, the Series A partner, one independent.

failures.html: Runs out of runway before distribution works.
